claims.text: Discover where rural populations are expanding and shrinking fastest around the world, from the Netherlands to Oman.
The rural population in the Netherlands is shrinking by 6.6%. In Oman, it's growing by 3.8%.
This counts everyone in areas outside cities, calculated as total population minus urban population.
claims.support: Definition: Rural population refers to people living in rural areas as defined by national statistical offices. It is calculated as the difference between total population and urban population.

claims.text: Big countries diverge. India is growing by 0.4%, while Brazil is down 2%.
The fastest growing countrysides climb steeply: Niger at 2.8%, Saudi Arabia at 3.6%, and Syria at 3.7%.
